description:
Modify the bundled Stroop demo experiment in PsychoPy Builder.

PsychoPy includes demo experiments. You need to open the Stroop demo, make specific modifications, and save the modified version.

REQUIREMENTS:
1. Open the Stroop demo experiment from:
   - /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/demos/ (if demos were unpacked)
   - Or use the Demos menu in PsychoPy
2. Make these modifications:
   a. Change the loop repetitions (nReps) to 3
   b. Add a new routine called 'instructions' at the beginning of the experiment flow (before the trial loop)
   c. In the instructions routine, add a text component telling participants to press the space bar to begin
   d. Add a keyboard component in the instructions routine that waits for the space key
3. Save the modified experiment as: /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/stroop_modified.psyexp

Do NOT overwrite the original demo file. The modified experiment should retain the original Stroop trial structure.
